sources.title: OLMo 2 - AI Wiki
sources.snippet: Most AI labs hand you a finished cake (the model weights) but keep the recipe secret. Ai2 hands you the cake, the recipe, every ingredient, the oven settings, and photos of the cake at every stage of baking. OLMo 2 is that fully open cake: anyone with enough computers can bake an identical one or swap an ingredient to see what changes.
